cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I read my mug aloud like you. Cheers. Now the little demon's chewing our cookbook; hold it while I fetch food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was reading a teabag label. Yours was a summoning spell.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Labels read, yes. Those novelty mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's swallowed a recipe and it's heading for the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give it my mug. You save the lease; let it chew the writing right off.

reason: Copied casual reading becomes summoning; printed cookbook prepares word diet and A helpful mug sacrifice simultaneously removes causal writing.
